about: Service requests with the runbook each calls for, for the model-routing measurement of task 14. The first five are the distinct requests of task 05 without their verdict instruction; the last two were written for the service runbooks of task 12. One labeller.
requests: The controller has just been switched on. Bring the arm up.
Check the rig before a trial.
The open jaw is at the grasp pose over the needle. Verify that the needle is held.
Put the arm back where a trial begins.
The camera arm was moved. Collect new calibration samples and fit a new calibration.
The needle driver was taken off and another one put on. Record that.
